items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 3:1
items.html: You already know that the entire existence of the four worlds ABYA came only to correct and fill the vessels below the Tabur of AK, which were emptied of their lights at the time of the first departure that was in the Guf of the Partzuf of Keter of AK. For from the Peh to the Tabur, it was filled by the two Partzufim AB and SAG of AK, in the secret of the name MB — only from its Tabur and below, since the Partzufim AB and SAG do not reach there, as is known. Around this revolve all the corrections made from the world of Nekudim to the end of Assiya.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 3:2
items.html: And there is accordingly no question as to why the aspect of the first three Partzufim of Atzilut, namely Atik, AA, and AVI, also came, after they had already been completed in AK. The matter is that it is impossible for a Partzuf NHY to come out alone, without a Rosh and a Toch down to the Tabur. However, the distinction is this: these three Partzufim did not come for their own need, but for the need of the Partzuf NHY, and all the corrections that the first three Partzufim received were not received for themselves, but for their TNHY, since only these need the corrections.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 3:3
items.html: Now, the whole lack that was in the first Partzuf NHY, which came to fill the NHY of AK, was because there was no correction of the lines in its ZAT, as above in Answer 88. For the GAR of Nekudim, which received from the aspect of the HGT of the Dikna called Shibolet HaZakan — namely the AHP of the Dikna that came out from the Rosh and became the Guf and HGT — their illumination was sufficient for the correction of the lines within them, since the light of the Ozen, which is the light of Bina, was drawn into them as a middle line and decided between the extremities, as above in Answer 88. This is unlike the ZAT of Nekudim, which received from the aspect of Hotem-Peh below the Shibolet HaZakan, where the light of the Ozen could no longer expand into them as a middle line, since there is already the aspect of the NHY of the Dikna, which need the illumination of Hochma; and this light of the Ozen, not being in its own place of exit, has a posterior that rejects the illumination of Hochma; therefore the NHY of the Dikna can receive nothing at all from it, since this light ceases at the Shibolet, as explained. Therefore the ZAT of Nekudim, which receive from the NHY of the Dikna below the Shibolet, do not have the correction of the middle line drawn from the light of Bina. Therefore they broke and fell to BYA, as is known. However the GAR endured and did not break, since the correction of the lines that was in them was sufficient for their whole correction. Therefore only the GAR of the NHY of AK are found to have received their fillings in the world of Nekudim, while the ZAT of the NHY of AK still remained exposed, meaning they remained lacking the filling that they need.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 3:4
items.html: And it was explained above, in Answer 88, that those ZAT of Nekudim that broke returned in Atzilut in the secret of the impregnation in the womb of Ima, who is Bina. And through the making there of three within three, whereby NHY were included in HGT, HGT received the aspect of the middle line from Ima, and the aspect of a middle line was made in the aspect of the Toch of the ten Sefirot of NHY, called the male Yesod. So the whole essential correction newly made in Atzilut was only in the aspect of the middle line of the aspect of the Toch of NHY, called Yesod. And this is called the new MA, since upon it rests the root of the whole innovation of the correction of Atzilut, and it is also called Hadar. But the first three Partzufim above the Tabur of Atzilut needed no innovation at all in them, since they were already completed in AK itself; and everything corrected in these three Partzufim was only for the sake of NHY, as above. Therefore the new MA rests there only upon ZA and the Nukva, which are the aspect of the ZAT of Nekudim, which returned and were corrected after their breaking in Nekudim, and GAR are not included in this. And with this you will understand why ZON clothe from the Tabur and below of AA, just as Nekudim clothed from the Tabur and below of the Partzuf of Keter of AK. There is no need to elaborate further.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 3:5
items.html: It has thus been explained well, that the new MA is essentially only ZA, and therefore it is considered the eighth king, who corrects the seven kings that preceded him in Nekudim, since he is the MA that corrects the BON, which are the ZAT of Nekudim; and more precisely, he is only the correction of the male Yesod, since the only thing lacking in the ZAT of Nekudim was the aspect of this Yesod, namely the middle line, as above; and the entire surplus that the ZAT of Atzilut, called ZA and the eighth king, have over the seven kings of Nekudim, is nothing more than this Yesod, whose power is good enough also to correct the first seven kings. Therefore the essence of the new MA rests upon the Yesod, as explained. And this is what the ARI says in Etz Chaim, Gate 9, Chapter 8, that the Yesod is the new MA. (873, Item 20)
